section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Acceptance by Others Scale (BAOS), a 10-item measure assessing individuals' perceptions of body acceptance from external sources (friends, family, dating partners, society, and media). Participants rated items on a 5-point scale, with higher scores reflecting greater perceived body acceptance. The scale demonstrated good reliability (Cronbach's α = .90 for women, .92 for men) and prior validation among US adults.
